mutants.description: The connected patch winner must use triangle area in all three weighted RGB sums; dropping the factors makes the unequal-area and swapped-area rows disagree with their independent red/blue expectations.
Step 3 must choose the nearest adjacent cluster to the weighted average; reversing the comparison leaves the selected component on the wrong fallback assignment and fails the swapped-area blue row.
Every face in the connected unclustered component must receive the selected Step 3 cluster; forcing cluster zero loses the swapped-area blue assignment.
